Michael Tatum]] | java=[[Hiroki Takahashi]] | }} '''Tobias''' (Japanese: '''タクト''' ''Takuto'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who competed in the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. He made his debut appearance in ''[[DP183|League Unleashed!]]''. ==History== [[File:Ash and Tobias.png|thumb|left|250px|Tobias and Ash]] Tobias first appeared in ''[[DP183|League Unleashed!]]'', where he was obscured in shadows the entire time. {{an|Barry}} passed him in a hallway and was scared by the way he came off. In ''[[DP184|Casting a Paul on Barry!]]'', while {{Ash}} and Barry were looking up information about their next League opponents, [[Conway]] told them that Tobias managed to easily obtain his eight [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s and advance through the first two rounds of the Lily of the Valley Conference using just his {{p|Darkrai}}. Barry was amazed by his shadowy and mysterious presence. In ''[[DP185|Working on a Right Move!]]'', Tobias appeared unshadowed for the first time, and he was revealed to have advanced into the quarterfinals. In ''[[DP188|Battling a Thaw in Relations!]]'', it was shown that he had advanced yet again, now moving onto the semifinals of the Lily of the Valley Conference. In ''[[DP189|The Semi-Final Frontier!]]'', he had a [[Full Battle]] against Ash in the semifinals. Although he was able to gain an early lead as his Darkrai alone defeated three of Ash's Pokémon, he eventually had to send out another Pokémon when [[Ash's Sceptile]] managed to overcome Darkrai's attacks and knock it out. Tobias then called out his Latios, who managed to defeat the remainder of Ash's team while [[fainting]] itself, winning the match for Tobias. Later, Tobias defeated his final round opponent with just his {{p|Darkrai}}, thus winning the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] and earning the right to participate in the {{DL|Pokémon League|Champion League}}. During the closing ceremonies, he was seen posing alongside {{an|Cynthia}} and [[Charles Goodshow]] while holding his trophy. ==Character== Tobias was a very mysterious person at first; his appearance and manner visibly disturbed {{an|Barry}} when they first passed each other in a hallway. He takes battling very seriously, but he also has a sportsmanlike side, as seen when he complimented Ash for defeating his Darkrai and putting up a good fight against him. Because of his serious dedication to battling, he could also become rather impatient when the end of a battle was near, such as when his Latios battled Ash's Pikachu. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Tobias's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tobias |pkmn=Darkrai |type1=Dark |img=Tobias Darkrai.png |epnum=DP183 |epname=League Unleashed! |vajp=Kenta Miyake |vaen=Kenta Miyake |desc={{p|Darkrai}} is Tobias's main Pokémon. Using only Darkrai, Tobias easily won eight [[Badge]]s in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]] and quickly advanced through the first four rounds of the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. Darkrai was first seen defeating a Trainer's {{p|Machamp}} in the first round. In ''[[DP189|The Semi-Final Frontier!]]'', Darkrai faced {{Ash}} and his Pokémon in the semi-finals of the tournament. It managed to defeat his {{AP|Heracross}}, {{AP|Torkoal}}, and {{AP|Gible}} with ease, before finally meeting its match in [[Ash's Sceptile]]. In the finals, Darkrai defeated Tobias's opponent's entire team, making him the winner of the tournament. Darkrai's known moves are {{m|Ice Beam}}, {{m|Dark Void}}, {{m|Dream Eater}}, and {{m|Dark Pulse}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tobias |pkmn=Latios |gender=male |type1=Dragon |type2=Psychic |img=Tobias Latios.png |epnum=DP189 |epname=The Semi-Final Frontier! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Latios}} was the second Pokémon that Tobias used in his battle against Ash. He was able to easily defeat both Sceptile and {{AP|Swellow}} in a row. [[Ash's Pikachu]], however, was able to provide a challenge for Latios, ultimately resulting in a double knockout. However, since this made Ash run out of usable Pokémon, Tobias won the battle and moved on to the finals. Latios's known moves are {{m|Giga Impact}}, {{m|Luster Purge}}, and {{m|Light Screen}}.}} It is assumed that Tobias has at least four other Pokémon, as he participated in a Full Battle with Ash, which requires six Pokémon. ==Achievements== [[File:Tobias Winning.png|thumb|250px|Tobias with the Lily of the Valley Championship Trophy]] ===Badges obtained=== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Tobias has obtained in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]: * At least eight Badges (prior to ''[[DP182|An Old Family Blend!]]'') ===Pokémon League=== Tobias has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] - Winner (''[[DP189|The Semi-Final Frontier!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{dark color}}|bordercolor={{dark color light}} |de=Patrick Schröder |ja=高橋広樹 ''Hiroki Takahashi'' |en=J. Also from '''達克'''萊伊 ''Dákèláiyī'', {{p|Darkrai}}. |- style="background:#FFF;" | Russian | Тобиас ''Tobias'' |Transcription of his English name. |} ==Trivia== * Tobias's design, from his color scheme to his physical features, was most probably based on his main Pokémon, {{p|Darkrai}}. * Tobias is the first character in the {{pkmn|animated series}} to own a [[Mythical Pokémon]], and the second character in animated series-related media altogether, after the [[Iron-Masked Marauder]]. * He is the first character in the animated series to participate in a [[Pokémon League Conference]] using a {{pkmn2|Legendary}} and/or Mythical Pokémon, although another Trainer did attempt to enter the League with his {{p|Heatran}}; however, it is unknown whether this Trainer actually participated or how far he made it in the League. ** Tobias is the first Trainer known to enter a Pokémon League using a Pokémon that is generally banned in official competitive battling environments. * Tobias's {{p|Latios}} is the only Pokémon in {{aniseries|PTS}} to have used the move {{m|Luster Purge}}. * Tobias is the only Trainer in the animated series to have officially owned both a Legendary and a Mythical Pokémon. * Even though his face is covered in his debut in ''[[DP183|League Unleashed!]]'', Tobias still appears in ''[[DP182|An Old Family Blend!]]'' on the match up board for the upcoming battles in the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] in the bottom right corner with a clear image of his face. ** Despite this, Tobias was not shown among the 64 Trainers that attended the opening ceremony in this episode. ==Related articles== {{Animecharacters|dark}} {{Leaguetrainers|dark}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Animation characters]] [[Category:Trainers with Legendary Pokémon]] [[Category:Trainers with Mythical Pokémon]] [[de:Tobias (Sinnoh)]] [[es:Tobías]] [[fr:Tobias]] [[it:Tobias (Sinnoh)]] [[ja:タクト]] [[zh:達克多]]
